prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1484; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and limited range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force and direction of the crash, and the clinical picture aligns well with a cervical strain. Over the course of 21 visits, care proceeded along a conventional path, combining manual therapy, targeted stretching, and graduated strengthening. Visit frequency decreased steadily as symptoms improved and function returned. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury to the cervical region. No prior injury or treatment involving the same body area is known to this provider. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service rendered, with no duplicated entries. At discharge the patient reported near-resolution of symptoms and was released to full activity with a home exercise program.
